workflowNotes: Use the controlReference as a line/depth/ControlNet guide rather than as direct training art.
Start from v40 when preserving the current app-first body/color balance matters; use v43 only as a head/color review reference until a body-lock route proves the dorsal armor is not too tiled.

Reject outputs if the head reads as a smooth lizard, the color collapses to plain tan-brown, the tail club is missing/detached/split, or the body reads as crocodile/monitor lizard even when armor texture looks attractive.
Reject outputs with tall dorsal plates, over-regular tiled armor grids, or fantasy spikes; Ankylosaurus needs varied low rounded osteoderms, not a Stegosaurus row or a hard shell.
